title: Shanghai International Children’s Book Fair 2024
excerpt: Our third international fair with our own stand took us to the Asian market, with rights meetings and conversations with printers and manufacturers.
image_alt: The Epsilon Publishing Group team at our stand, Shanghai International Children’s Book Fair 2024
body:
2024 was certainly a year of book fairs and travel for Epsilon Publishing Group, and our journey to the Shanghai International Children’s Book Fair marked another milestone: our third international fair with our own stand in the Asian market.

Shanghai offered a distinctly different experience, with a smaller section dedicated to international rights meetings and a much larger area where Chinese publishers sold books directly to readers. This combination gave us the opportunity to explore potential rights partnerships while seeing how books were presented to local families. Meeting printers and manufacturers also opened up conversations about formats, materials and production possibilities, offering fresh inspiration for our own publishing programme. We returned with new connections and a broader perspective on both the Chinese market and the possibilities shaping the future of children’s publishing.
